A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

susceptibility to CVB3-induced myocarditis increases with age in males and in females, and this susceptibility is related to the ability of the animal to mount an effective immune response to the virus.
susceptibility to CVB3-induced myocarditis in the Balb/c strain of mice is a function of the age and the gender of the animal.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the susceptibility of the host to viral myocarditis is not static but varies with age and sex.
the immune responses of the host are critical to the severity of CVB3-induced myocarditis.
